Container.Name: shiftledger
Container.Overview: StaffWeek by ShiftLedger: multi-store employee schedules, overnight shifts, manager logins, time tracking and estimated payroll. Data remains under /mnt/user/appdata/shiftledger/data. For a new database, supply an initial owner password.

Config.Name: Persistent data
Config.Description: Keep this exact path when migrating; it holds your existing employees, stores, schedules and payroll records.

Config.Name: Owner username on first startup
Config.Description: Only used if the database has no users; existing logins are preserved.

Config.Name: Initial owner password
Config.Description: For an existing ShiftLedger database leave blank; the existing login is preserved. For a brand new database supply an initial password.
